still_wrong.kind: new (not in the four reviews; the hit order is v15.1's, so not caused by the fixes)
still_wrong.title: In Select, the points of a 3-point Circle cannot be dragged: the press picks the circle and moves the whole construction
still_wrong.detail: editDown's hit test goes topmost first and puts only areas last. A 3-point Circle (Curve mode) always comes after its points in the list and always passes through them, so a press on z0, z1 or z2 hits the circle. The drag then translates every root (SPEC 4.3), so the circle never changes shape. The defining points can be dragged only in Region mode (a disc is an area, so the point wins). constr_cmd misses it because its drag test uses zeros and gliders, which win for other reasons.
still_wrong.evidence: test/vrf_cdp/c/d2.js and d3.js: circle3(z0, z1, z2) with fill 'none', Select. A click on z1 = (1, -0.5) selects s4 (the circle), not s2. Dragging from z1 to (1.5, 0) moves all three points by (0.5, 0.5); r stays 1.0885. Selecting the circle first changes nothing. With fill 'in' (d5.js) the same drag moves only that point, as expected.
still_wrong.fix: In editDown, test point shapes within 7 px before curves (or prefer a point over any curve at the same press), then the curves. Check bound lines, segments and arcs as well, since they also pass through their points. Add a constr_cmd check that drags z1 of a 3-point Circle in Curve mode.

still_wrong.kind: caused by the picture-7 / user-12 fixes
still_wrong.title: The Russian export caption has English inside it: 'и~the line through $z_{0}$ and $z_{1}$'
still_wrong.detail: A meet's caption names its curves through A.capPhrase(c, 'gen'). For a line bound at both ends, shapePhrase returns the English bound-line phrase, which has no genitive and no translation. constr_cmd stores the caption in info.capRu but does not check it, so the suite passes.
still_wrong.evidence: constr_cmd info.capRu (my run): '... точка пересечения $z_{3}=0{,}866+0{,}5i$ окружности $|z|=1$ и~the line through $z_{0}$ and $z_{1}$ и~круг, ...'. The EN caption is fine.
still_wrong.fix: Give the bound-line, segment, ray and half-plane phrases a genitive form ('прямой, проходящей через точки $z_0$ и $z_1$', and so on) in v16-constructions.json, used when capPhrase is called with 'gen'. Add a check that capRu has no Latin words outside $...$.

still_wrong.title: Dragging a point with 50 dependents is slower than the AS-BUILT figure
still_wrong.detail: 1 and 10 dependents are unchanged and meet BUDGET60. At 50 dependents the frame is about 50 % slower than the number in AS-BUILT, although the machine was less loaded. 50 is 'reported, not met' in SPEC 3 [C3c], so this is not a gate failure. The pre-fix build was not kept, so I could not pair the runs.
still_wrong.evidence: constr_cmd section F, two runs on test/vrf_cdp, load average about 5: 50 dependents rAF work p95 30.9 and 29.3 ms, frame p95 50.1 and 50 ms. AS-BUILT.md F (pre-fix, load average up to 19): 20.3 ms, frame p95 33.4 ms. 1: 2.0-2.5 ms (was 2.4); 10: 5.2-5.3 ms (was 5.7).
still_wrong.fix: Rebuild the pre-fix sources (the reviewed constr.js and construct.js) and run section F paired and interleaved with the current build. If the gap holds, profile the drag. Likely suspects are the per-frame work added by the fixes: drawSources and the dimming (user-9), and exact-form strokes for big circles.
